§6Steam Engine§f

§aBest power-per-buck before turbines. And it looks cool doing it.§f

Craft at a Tier 2 anvil: dense stone ×16, steel plates ×12, steel shells ×2, copper coils ×4, large gear.

The setup: §bFirebox§f -> §bBoiler§f (water to steam) -> §bSteam Engine§f -> §bSteam Condenser§f (low-pressure steam back to water). Closed loop, no water loss.

§e3,400 HE/t§f output (68 kHE/s). Handles §e2,000 mB/t§f steam throughput.

The boiler needs a heat source underneath and a Fluid ID set to input water. Always include the steam condenser or you'll run out of water fast.

§ePS:§f See the Boiler quest for the multiblock details.
